# 🏠 Daily Real Estate Deal Finder

## 📄 Overview
This automation sends you daily real estate deals via email every morning at 9AM. It searches markets you specify with strict criteria, fetches listings from Zillow API, calculates investment metrics, saves to Google Sheets, and emails you the best deals.

## 🔑 Required Credentials

### 1. Google OAuth2
- **Purpose**: Google Sheets access
- **Setup Video**: https://youtu.be/LTuy83t_Rt4
- Enable Google Sheets API in Google Cloud Console

### 2. RapidAPI - Zillow API
- **Purpose**: Property listings & rent estimates
- Sign up at https://rapidapi.com
- Subscribe to Zillow API
- Copy your API key

### 3. Gmail OAuth2
- **Purpose**: Send daily email digest
- Uses same Google OAuth setup

## 📋 Google Sheet Setup
Create a new Google Sheet with these columns:
- **A**: Address
- **B**: Price
- **C**: Rent Zestimate
- **D**: Cash on Cash ROI
- **E**: Monthly Cash Flow
- **F**: Down Payment
- **G**: Monthly Maintenance
- **H**: Vacancy Loss
- **I**: Property URL
- **J**: Date Added

## ⚙️ Configuration Steps
1. Import this workflow
2. Connect Google Sheets credential
3. Add RapidAPI credential to HTTP node
4. Update search parameters in 'Set Parameters' node
5. Link your Google Sheet ID in Sheets node
6. Add your email in Gmail node
7. Test manually, then activate!

## 🧮 Investment Metrics Calculated
- **Down Payment**: 20% of purchase price
- **Monthly Mortgage**: 30-year fixed estimate
- **Vacancy Loss**: 8% of rent
- **Maintenance**: 10% of rent
- **Cash Flow**: Rent - Mortgage - Expenses
- **Cash on Cash ROI**: Annual Cash Flow / Down Payment

## 🕘 Part 1: Daily Trigger
Runs every day at 9:00 AM

## ⚙️ Part 2: Search Criteria
Define your market & property requirements

## 🏘️ Part 3: Zillow API
Fetch listings & rent estimates from RapidAPI

## 🧮 Part 4: Investment Metrics
Calculate Down PMT, Cash Flow, ROI, etc.

## ✅ Part 5: Filter Good Deals
Only keep properties with positive cash flow

## 📊 Part 6: Save & Email
Store in Google Sheets & send email digest

## ℹ️ Note
If no properties have positive cash flow, the email will still send with a message saying no deals were found.

## ⚠️ Configure These Values!
- **location**: Your target market (e.g., "Austin, TX")
- **min/max_price**: Your budget range
- **min_beds/baths**: Minimum requirements
- **down_payment_pct**: Default 20%
- **interest_rate**: Current mortgage rate
- **recipient_email**: Your email address

## 🔑 RapidAPI Setup
1. Go to rapidapi.com
2. Search for "Zillow API"
3. Subscribe to a plan
4. Create HTTP Header Auth credential:
   - **Header Name**: X-RapidAPI-Key
   - **Header Value**: Your API key
5. Add second header:
   - **Header Name**: X-RapidAPI-Host
   - **Header Value**: zillow-com1.p.rapidapi.com
